# Termux-Train Full Technical Specification (v1.0.0)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
Ultra-Lightweight On-Device Tensor & DAG Autograd Deep Learning Framework
Implements a pure C++/Python dynamic computation DAG with SafeTensors zero-copy serialization and memory-mapped LoRA backpropagation on ARM64.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: termux-train
- Command: pip install termux-train
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/termux-train

## 3. Core Capabilities
- **Zero-Copy SafeTensors Serialization**: Loads and saves model checkpoints with zero memory duplication via mmap.
- **Dynamic DAG Autograd Engine**: Closed-form gradient computation with minimal heap allocation during backward pass.
- **On-Device LoRA Fine-Tuning**: Optimized low-rank adaptation matrix training directly on mobile CPU/NEON cores.

## 4. Canonical Implementation
```python
import termux_train as tt

# 1. Define model with LoRA layers
model = tt.nn.TransformerLoRA(vocab_size=32000, dim=512, lora_rank=8)
optimizer = tt.optim.AdamW(model.parameters(), lr=1e-4)

# 2. Train on-device with zero memory overhead
for epoch in range(5):
    loss = model(inputs, targets)
    loss.backward()
    optimizer.step()
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    print(f"Epoch {epoch}: Loss = {loss.item():.4f}")

```
